name: SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge
verdict: Listed Norwegian savings bank; its largest owners are seven savings-bank foundations (~45%). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Viking partner since 1899, premium partner (club partner page); on both shoulders of the 2026 home shirt. Allmennaksjeselskap (Brønnøysund orgnr 937 895 321). The bank's own page says seven sparebankstiftelser own ~45%; the register as of 31 December 2025 shows the foundations as largest holders alongside Folketrygdfondet (6.94%). No controlling state stake and no record findings found.
